instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run tool:read-a-treg-call", and give it account, call_id.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-a-treg-call and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: An answer with the fields call, async_task, ledger, charged_micro.
